en.description:
I wanted nothing but the ease of oblivion, at first. I floated ignorant in baths of nepenthe, a second gestation. Unseeing, unspeaking. Only rarely did my brain flicker errant light across the cave-paintings still smeared on the interior of my skull. 

At sensation's edge I knew a vague silhouette of Loid crooning motherly across the watery distances, the poetry my tongue was too blackened to recite.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - The Aftermath

zh.description:
起初，我除了遗忘带来的安逸，什么也不想要。我毫无念想地漂浮在忘忧草浴中，仿佛进入了第二次孕育。不见世事，不发一言。我的脑海中偶尔会闪过游离的光线，照亮了那残留在我头骨内的洞穴壁画。 

在感知的尽头，我隐约认出了一个模糊的轮廓，那是洛德，隔水相望，如同慈母般低声吟唱。我的舌头太过污浊，无法诵出那歌谣。
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 后续

en.description:
I employed a variety of Cavia in an attempt to unmake the adversary. 

The principle was straightforward enough, though in hindsight I abhor my naivete. My humanity had been unscrolled by the caustic Void and now smirked back at me across the divide, privy to all my unfettered malice and pettiness. In answer, I resolved to hurl into the Void minds that were not human. Let it parody them. The proximity of the bestial would force a humbling devolution, or so I thought.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - The Cavia

zh.description:
我用多种科维兽试图消灭对手。

这个原理足够简单，尽管事后回想起来我讨厌自己的天真。我的人性被腐蚀性的虚空揭开，而现在又隔着鸿沟对我笑，对我所有肆无忌惮的恶意和狭隘了如指掌。作为回应，我决定将非人的思想投入到虚空。让虚空去拙劣地模仿它们。野性的接近将迫使它经历一场屈辱的退化。至少我是怎么认为的。
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 科维兽

en.description:
In Duviri, I woke every day to the voice of my daughter. I recoiled from this at first, feeling the sting of conscience. I could not confront, even in semblance, the woman I had abandoned. Instead I reinvented myself as a teacher, advising the child-King of the menace beyond his borders.

But as the days melted away, I came to recognize the strange cast of characters Euleria had created, and their purpose. I heard voices I had myself first conjured in the darkness of her childhood chambers, for no other reward than her delight. She had not only preserved this gift I had thought so trivial, she had made it an instrument of healing. More: a stronghold.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - Duviri

zh.description:
在双衍王境， 我每天都在我女儿的声音中醒来。起初，我因良心的责备而退缩。我无法面对我所抛弃的女儿，哪怕只是表面上的。于是我改头换面成为一位师长，告诫少年国王注意他王境之外的威胁。

但随着时光流逝，我开始认出欧拉瑞娅创造的那些古怪角色及其目的。我听到了那些声音，那是我最初在她孩童时代房间的漆黑中召唤出来的，不求任何回报，只为了她的喜悦。她不仅保留了这份我曾认为微不足道的礼物，还把它变成了一种治愈的工具。不仅如此：它还成为了一个堡垒。
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 双衍王境

en.description: I went among the denizens of the plague year like a savior, my hands filled with healing. To those who volunteered, I brought more than mere health. Their bodies were primed; it needed only the Helminth infusions, brought from my own time, to work the alchemy of transformation. They have become partial Warframes, still in possession of their free will, yet enhanced, Void-attuned, capable.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - The Vessels

zh.description: 我在瘟疫之年的居民中穿行，如同一个救世主，双手充满治愈之力。对于那些自愿者，我带去的不仅仅是健康。他们的身体已经做好了准备；只需要从我自己的时代带来的 Helminth 注入，就能实现转化的炼金术。他们已经成为了部分战甲，仍保有自由意志，同时得到了增强，适应虚空，能力出众。
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 承载体

en.description:
All is in readiness. Loid will do as he is bid, though his eyes silently plead with me to choose another path.


As I await my final crossing to the past, I ponder what role a scientist may play in so spiritual a matter as 'absolution'. How in the alchemy of the soul, even repentance must necessarily be a calculated task.

I will repair what I have broken, no more and no less. The scales must balance. And in such a monstrous penitence as this, I shall take no heed of the dust that may fall upon them on either side, the dust of petty lives.

The builders of old tempered their mortar with blood, to appease the most ancient of land-spirits. We should have been so wise. Yet it is not too late to learn.

The sands fall. The circuit completes. I return to the place of the beginning.

Let witless hordes bleat their disdain for every fervent plan;
The deal is done, the die is cast. I end as I began.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - We End as we Began

zh.description:
一切已准备就绪。洛德会按照命令行事，尽管他的眼神在无声地恳求我选择另一条道路。


在我等待着最后一次穿越到过去，我在思索，一个科学家在'赦免'这样一个灵性问题上能发挥什么作用。在灵魂的炼金术中，即使是悔改也必然是一项经过计算的任务。

我将修复我所破坏的，不多也不少。天平必须保持平衡。在这样巨大的忏悔面前，我不会关心任何一边上可能落下的尘埃，那些琐碎人生的尘埃。

古代建筑师用血液混合砂浆，以安抚最古老的土地神灵。我们本应如此明智。然而，现在学习还不算晚。

沙子落下，循环闭合。我回到了一切的起点。

任由那些无知人们对每个热切计划表示轻蔑吧；
交易已成，命运已定。我出于尘土，也归于尘土
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 我出于尘土，也归于尘土

en.description: The Old War found humanity facing a technologically superior force, and their own weapons were turned against them. Melee and ballistic weapons, inspired by primitive counterparts, became part of the Tenno arsenal to circumvent the Sentient interference of more technologically-involved weaponry.
en.name: Archaic Weapons

zh.description: 远古之战中人类发现敌对力量拥有科技的优势，而人类的武器被用来反噬自己。受到原始武器的启发，近战与弹道武器被纳入了 Tenno 的武器库之中，来避开 Sentient 对高科技武器的干扰作用。
zh.name: 复古武器

en.description: Ceres is the extreme example of the Grineer's utilitarian ignorance of the natural landscape. Their expanding shipyard operations pollute and shroud the planet in smog and industrial waste as they manufacture machines of war. These foundries are scattered across the Origin System, giving them near-limitless reach with their fleets.
en.name: Ceres

zh.description: 谷神星是 Grineer 对自然景观的功利主义与无知体现的极端案例。当他们生产战争机器时，其不断扩增的造船事业造成了严重污染，使得整座星球笼罩在一片废气之中。这些铸造厂四散于始源星系，使他们的舰队有着近乎无止尽的拓展空间。
zh.name: 谷神星

en.description: While the major warring factions combat each other across the Origin System, non-militant organizations and civilian merchants populate the many regional Tenno Relays. Travelling merchant collectors that offer rare goods, mentors that offer training and knowledge, and convictional syndicates that preach their own rituals and doctrine.
en.name: Citizens

zh.description: 当几个主要的交战派系在始源星系中彼此交火争战之际，非军方组织与民间商人汇集到众多地区性的 Tenno 中继站中。这些移民中有着出售稀世珍宝的旅行贸易收藏家、提供训练与知识的导师们，也有宣扬自己仪式与教义的信仰集团。
zh.name: 平民

en.description: Predominantly a merchant guild, Corpus labour and security forces are composed mostly of purpose-bred humanoid crewmen, and animal-like robots; both equally indoctrinated into a ritualized and propagandist devotion to labour and work.
en.name: Corpus Crew

zh.description: 主体为一个商人公会，为求温饱的人类船员、类动物形态的机器人所组成了劳动力与保安部队。而两者皆被程序化洗脑，宣扬着献身于劳务和工作的理念。
zh.name: Corpus 船员

en.description: Lead by innovatory and elusive industrialists, and claiming to be descendants of Orokin lineage, the Corpus are dedicated to the accumulation of wealth. This elite ruling class operates an insular trade organization using humans and robotics for labour and security, and have been condemned by the Seven as a merchant cult.
en.name: Corpus

zh.description: 由一群创新且难以捉模的企业家们所领导，他们自认是奥罗金血脉的后裔，并致力于累积财富。这个精英统治阶级利用人类与机器人提供劳力与安全防护，运作着一个独立的贸易组织。这个组织因此被七人众定罪为商业邪教。
zh.name: Corpus

en.description:
Day after day we toiled, my father, my brother Cladius, pulling grains for the Orokin takers in the city, as our kind had done for generations. We were young but the work made us old. Our backs ached, our hands bled, the sun tortured our skin. In the worst times, it felt as though death would claim us before the day was through. It was on one such afternoon that I was fated to first hear that glorious sound. A whisper I strained to hear. In a tongue not of man, but of something… else. Something... grander. A language I understood instinctively. The language of Desire. It said:

"Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms."
en.name: Humble Beginnings

zh.description:
我的父亲，我的弟弟克拉迪乌斯，日复一日地工作着，我们世世代代都是为城里的奥罗金收割者们收取庄稼的。尽管我们还年轻，但工作使我们日渐沧桑。我们的背部酸痛，双手流血，太阳炙烤我们的皮肤。在最艰难的时期，似乎只有死亡才能把我们在日子过去前解放出来。正是在这样一个下午，如命中注定般地，我首次听到了一个充满荣耀的声音。那是一道让我竖起耳朵倾听的耳语。这道声音并不是人类的语言，而是……另一种……更高级的语言。这是一种我可以本能地理解的语言。也就是欲望的语言。它说：
 
"不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。"
zh.name: 生于微末

en.description:
The more we toiled the more impatient I grew. A fire raged inside me. I wanted more. I deserved more.

But how? The whisper washed over me, louder now than before:

"Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward."

And so, with only the whisper to guide me, I straightened my back, wiped the dirt from my hands, and left.
en.name: To The City

zh.description:
我们付出的劳动越多，我就越没有耐心。我的内心熊熊燃烧。我想要更多。我应该得到更多。

但要怎么做？这道耳语充斥着我，声音比以前更大了：

"财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。"

因此，仅靠这道耳语引导我，我挺直了腰板，擦去手上的污垢，然后就走了。
zh.name: 前往城市

en.description:
The city. Those towers. I was struck with awe. What glorious totems of greed these Orokin had built. Built on. Our. Backs. Their wealth was my wealth. I was starved, while our masters were fat. and full. and warm. They flaunted their wealth, left it sitting there for the taking: priceless gemstones decorating the tower gates. I was afraid, but the whisper gave me courage.

"Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire."

So, that is what I did.
en.name: What Right Do They Have?

zh.description:
这个城市。那些高塔。我感到敬畏。这些奥罗金建造了多么辉煌的贪婪图腾。建造在、我、们、的、背、上。他们的财富也就是我的财富。我快饿死了，而我们的主人又胖、又饱、又暖和。他们炫耀自己的财富，把财富留在那里任由拿取：无价的宝石装饰在塔门上。我很害怕，但是这道耳语给了我勇气。

"嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。"

所以，我就那么做了。
zh.name: 他们凭什么？

en.description:
I was brash and bold. I struck at midday. I cried, "I take what I am owed!" as I ripped jewels from their tower gates and ran.

I did not get far.

For my blasphemy they dragged me to the tower square, throwing me to the ground in front of the sneering crowd of Orokin servants that mingled there.

The guards held aloft my satchel, containing the proof of my crime. I grasped at it, determined to reclaim what was mine. He snatched my arm, held me high and... with a dash of his plasma dagger... severed my left hand. The crowd jeered. Yet, I felt no pain, only clarity, for the whisper was with me again. It said:

"Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise."

They took my hand that day, but they did not take what I had earned.
en.name: The Taking

zh.description:
那时的我，正值血气方刚。我在正午时分开始了行动，叫喊着："我要拿回你们亏欠我的东西！"之后，我扣下了高塔大门上的宝石，转身就跑。

我并没有跑很远。

因为我的亵渎行为，他们把我拖到高塔广场，把我扔在地上，扔在嘲讽的人群面前，那里都是来往的奥罗金仆人们。

守卫高高举起我的背包，里面有着我犯罪的证据。我抓住了它，想要夺回属于我的东西。他抓起我的手臂，把我高高举起，然后……一把等离子匕首刺了进来……切断了我的左手。人群仍在哄笑。但是，我没有感觉到痛楚，只有清醒，因为耳语再次在我耳边说道：

"欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。"

那一天，他们夺走了我的手，但他们并没有夺去我挣来的东西。
zh.name: 巧取豪夺

en.description:
I crawled back to the fields, where I collapsed before my father and my brother. I was so near death they read my Nava rites. My brother Cladius bemoaned me as a fool. How could I have abandoned them? Guilt washed over me. I asked the whisper, was he right? And the whisper replied:

"Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness."

Hearing this, I felt the life force stream back into me.
I sat up. They protested. I stood and they tried to pull me down. I was too strong. There was now a fire in my chest that would not be denied.
en.name: Crawling Back

zh.description:
我爬回了田里，在父亲和弟弟面前倒下了。我当时只剩一口气了，他们为我念了我的临终祷告。我的弟弟克拉迪乌斯哀叹我是个傻子。我怎么能抛弃他们呢？罪恶感笼罩着我。我问那道耳语，他说得对吗？耳语的回答是：

"当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。"

听到这句话，我感觉生命之力重新流向了我。
我一下子坐了起来。他们却不让我起来。随后我站了起来，而他们又试图拉我躺下。我当时充满了力量。我的胸膛燃起了熊熊烈火，这团火不容否认。
zh.name: 落魄归去

en.description:
Moving swiftly from sick-bed to field, I fell to my knees beneath that relentless sun, my chest afire. As it moved to my throat, robbing me of breath, certain death had finally found me, I made one last heave.

I spat it out: a molten red gemstone of the purest, clearest rubedo.

Swallowing that stone would have killed a man of weaker will, but not a man sustained by the power of Desire.

It was worth more than my family had made in ten generations. It would fetch enough to feed us all for a lifetime. As I stared into its brilliant facets, a familiar voice rushed through me.

"Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires."

And so, with my brother and father pleading for my return. I once again left for the city.
en.name: The Gemstone

zh.description:
我从病床上疾奔回了田里，我在毒辣的太阳下屈膝，我的胸腔在燃烧。最终死神还是找到了我，它正抵着我的喉咙，使我喘不过气来，我挣扎着吐出了最后一丝生气。

然后我把它吐了出来：一颗炙热的红宝石，也就是最纯净、最清晰的红化结晶。

吞下那颗石头可能会杀死意志薄弱的人，但杀不死一个被欲望之力驱使的人。

这比我们家族累积十代的财产都要值钱。它足以养活我们一辈子。当我凝视这它璀璨的表面，一道熟悉的声音传来。

"知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。"

于是，伴随着我弟弟和父亲恳求我"回家吧"的声音。我再次离开前往了城里。
zh.name: 智慧结晶

en.description:
In desire I was wealthy, but in strategy I was empty-handed. I listened for the whisper, it said:

"Money begets money."

With my jewel as collateral, I secured a loan. And with that sum, I gave my own loans. To poor men, like me, who desired more. With each loan, I dispensed truths I had learned from the whisper. Those men went out into the world, and they too made loans, and their money too begat money. Word spread fast. Men flocked to hear me. I told them of the evils of contentment and idleness. I taught them the gift of Desire.
en.name: A New Beginning

zh.description:
在欲望中我很富有，但在策略上我两手空空。我听着耳语，它说：

"钱生钱。"

我以宝石为抵押，获得了一笔贷款。然后用这笔钱贷给像我一样渴望更多的穷人。每次借贷，我都会告诉他们我从耳语中学到的真理。那些人去到外面的世界，也放贷，也以钱生钱。消息散布得很快。人们蜂拥而至来听我说话。我告诉他们知足和懒惰的弊害。我教授他们何谓欲望的馈赠。
zh.name: 璀璨新生

en.description:
In time my money multiplied into multitudes. With this wealth, I made my body whole again.

Then news came: father had collapsed in the field. I rushed back to my family's humble farm to be by his side, but his death was sudden. Cladius mourned. But I was committed to ending the brutal labor my family and people had endured for generations. The whisper approved, it said:

"Charity is power. More charity is more power."
en.name: Giving Back

zh.description:
随着时间的推移，我的财富成倍积聚。通过这些财富，我又恢复为了完整之躯。

随后，我收到了父亲倒在田里的噩耗。我冲回家里的简陋农场，陪在他身边，然而他还是猝然离世了。克拉迪乌斯哀悼着他。但我决心要结束我们家世世代代忍受的残酷苦活。耳语声认同道：

"给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。"
zh.name: 施恩谋报

en.description:
Cladius begged me to stop my mega-dozers, "If you build a city on these fields what will we eat?" To which I replied, "Just as I consumed the gemstone that fed my fortune, our people will eat the wealth I have bestowed upon them."

"What of our home?" he cried, "Our traditions?" I pondered this until the whisper gave me the words:

"Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man."
en.name: Bury The Past

zh.description:
克拉迪乌斯恳求我停下巨型推土机的运行，"如果你在这些土地上建造城市，那我们吃什么？"我回答说："就像我花出的宝石增加了我的财富，我们的人民会在我赋予他们的财富上得到饱足。"

"那我们的家呢？"他喊道："我们的传统呢？"我陷入沉思，直到耳语告诉我这句话：

"避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。"
zh.name: 埋葬过去

en.description:
I believe my father would have smiled with pride as I smashed our family home into the dirt. It saddens me that Father did not live to see the glory of Corposium, the city I erected upon our meager land. Men of Desire will always be outnumbered by idle men, men of fear.  But small men can never hold back men of Strength, and Desire.

"Fulfill desire and others will follow."
en.name: A New Empire

zh.description:
当我们家被我推倒化为一片废墟时，我相信我父亲会面带自豪的微笑。令我感到难过的是，父亲没有活着看到我让 Corposium 之城从荒芜之地拔地而起的荣耀。充满欲望的人总是远少于懒惰，恐惧的人。但是，对于有权势和欲望的人，庸人永远不会成为他们的绊脚石。

"当你能满足欲望，其他人也将蜂拥追随。"
zh.name: 帝国崛起

en.description:
My gift to the future is an idea; an idea that wealth need not settle as a crust upon the upper echelons of the populace. No. Any poor grain farmer can, should he feed his Desire and apply his wisdom, take fortune for himself. The more the better. And, when men of fortune come together under great leadership, their potential is exponential.

Just as my money replaced what the Orokin took from me and made my body whole again, our collective Desire will create a new body. A body forged of fortune and unencumbered by idleness or sentimentality.

"Ours is the grasping golden hand. We are desire. We are Corpus."
en.name: We Are Corpus

zh.description:
作为给予未来的礼物，我有一个构想；一个想法，即不应只有凌驾于人民的上层阶级才能积累财富。不。任何贫穷的耕作农民都可以为自己积累财富，只要他能满足自己的欲望并运用他的智慧。财富越多就越好。而且，如果拥有财富的人联合起来并受到强有力的领导，他们的潜力便会成倍增长。

正如我的钱弥补了奥罗金从我这夺走的东西，并使我的躯体再次变得完整一样，我们的集体欲望将创造一具新的躯体。一具由财富铸造的躯体，并且不受懒惰和情感的制约。

"我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们是欲望的化身。我们是 Corpus。"
zh.name: 我们是 Corpus

en.description: The Grineer have reclaimed the abandoned dwellings of an ancient society which sprung up around a massive Orokin terra-forming device. Content to make use of the existing structures, Mars’ current occupants have established a base of military operations in one of the few regions that has a habitable climate moderated by Orokin technology.
en.name: Mars Settlement

zh.description: Grineer 重启了被古老社会所遗弃的住所，这些住所兴起于一个大型的奥罗金地球化改造装置。满足于利用现有的建筑结构，火星的新占领者在一个由奥罗金科技调节气候的宜居区域建立了军事基地。
zh.name: 火星殖民地

en.description: Newly awakened, and with no permanent location to call home, Tenno warriors have aligned to construct secret temples of their own. The architecture within is distinctly Tenno in origin, but these hidden palaces of bonding, training and meditation are undeniably influenced by Orokin architecture.
en.name: Dojo

zh.description: 才刚苏醒的 Tenno 战士们，没有能称为家的永久居所，他们必须合力建造属于自己的秘密圣殿。道场的内部架构原本具有鲜明的 Tenno 风格。但不可否认地，这座进行联络、训练及冥想的秘密殿堂，受到了不少奥罗金建筑架构的影响。
zh.name: 道场

en.description:
I am naturally curious. I can hardly help it. And so I set this down for any that follow in my footsteps, who wonder - as I have - about our home. 

Today, Duviri is a mere scattering of islands, set about the Palace as if they had spilled forth from it. But in the dawning time, when the Kingdom was new, it was a Kingdom worthy of the name.
en.name: We Are Not What We Were

zh.description:
我天性好奇，几乎不能自已。因此，我为了那些跟随我脚步的人，为了那些像我一样，想要了解我们家园的人写下了这些话。 

今天，双衍王境只是一座座散布在王宫周围的岛屿，仿佛它们是从王宫里溢出来的。但在最开始，当王境刚成立时，它是一个名副其实的王境。
zh.name: 我们今非昔比

en.description: When Duviri came into being there were many islands whose contents were - to put it bluntly- horrific. The Execution Cyst, the Golden Hive, the Inversion Tree, Stitcher’s Gulch and the Bountiful Swamp were all notorious, but each met a natural end, engulfed by the Void. Lorn was exiled deliberately.
en.name: The Island of Lorn

zh.description: 双衍王境诞生之初，许多岛屿上的事物……恕我直言，实在令人毛骨悚然。「处决包囊」「黄金蜂巢」「逆位之树」「缝合机峡谷」与「丰饶沼泽」无不恶名远扬，但最终都被虚空吞没，走向消亡。唯独孤魂岛，是被人为放逐的。
zh.name: 孤魂岛

en.description:
In all the ages of Thrax's reign, only two strangers have ever been known to come to Duviri. 

One was the monk, Teshin, who fell from the sky into the lake on the island we now call Hermit's Landing. Seemingly lifeless, he was dragged ashore by Mathila who nursed his return to health. I have never known a constitution to match his; yet unlike us, he has… deteriorated… with the passing of time.

The other stranger came far earlier in Thrax's reign, before even the Bleeding Earth.
en.name: Scholar’s Landing

zh.description:
在士魂大帝统治的所有时代当中，真要说起来，也只有两个陌生人来到过双衍王境。 

一位是个叫做 Teshin 的僧侣，他从天而降掉进了岛上的湖中，我们现在称那里为"隐临岛"。玛蒂拉把看上去毫无生命迹象的他拖上了岸，并照料他一直到他康复。我不知道谁有哪一种体质能跟他的体质相提并论；但他和我们不同，他，随着时间的流逝，状况已经越来越差。

另一个陌生人，在士魂大帝的统治早期就在这里了，甚至要早于"大地泣血"的时代。
zh.name: 儒临地

en.description: The Necropolis Island was once one of the largest in Duviri, and the strangest. It appeared to be a sprawling burial ground, littered with gravestones, wooden crosses, sarcophagi and ornate tombs. But those who broke into these places found that there were no bodies to loot. Not a cadaver, not a skull, not even a tooth.
en.name: The Doll Mausoleum

zh.description: 大墓岛曾经是双衍王境最大的岛屿之一，也是最奇怪的岛屿之一。它似乎是一个庞大的墓地，散落着墓碑、木制十字架、石棺和华丽的坟墓。但那些胆大妄为闯入这些地方的人却发现，这里没有尸体可以掠夺。没有尸体，没有头骨，甚至连颗牙齿也没有。
zh.name: 人偶陵墓

en.description:
The island of Manipura was Duviri's vineyard. The Calaventi merchant sisterhood had villas there. Their tenant farmers raised succulent grapes to be turned into wine, which was taken as a tribute to be shared among the Dax. 

Tribute day was a great celebration in the Dax barracks, as the veiled Yaskutai would pour bowl after bowl of wine, comrades would show old wounds and tell tall tales of how they were come by, and old songs would be sung late into the night.
en.name: Manipura Island

zh.description:
宝石之岛是双衍王境的葡萄园。卡拉文蒂商人姐妹会在那里拥有别墅。她们的佃农种植多汁的葡萄酿造葡萄酒，作为贡品供禁卫享用。 

进贡日在禁卫军营是一个盛大的庆祝活动，蒙着面纱的管家会一碗一碗地倒酒，战友们会露出旧伤并大谈特谈他们是怎么受伤的，并在深夜里唱着老歌。
zh.name: 宝石之岛

en.description: For Lake Verula to be lost and forgotten is a lasting bitterness to me. There was a time when it was Duviri's festival spot. On the anniversary of Thrax's coronation, the citizenry would build ceremonial floating islands. On these they would drift, sing, play music and light fragrant lanterns in honor of Thrax.
en.name: Lake Verula

zh.description: 维鲁拉湖的消失和被遗忘对我来说是一种非常漫长的痛苦。曾经有一段时间，这里是双衍王境的节日胜地。在士魂大帝的加冕周年纪念日中，国民们会建造仪式性的浮岛。他们会在上面漂浮、唱歌、演奏音乐并点亮芬芳的灯笼以纪念士魂大帝。
zh.name: 维鲁拉湖

en.description:
The island was called Cornucopia, for its fecundity. The soil, dark and rich, yielded tubers and greens that shimmered with life. Wagons laden with tribute would go tottering up to the Palace in procession. 

All this was, of course, the will of the King; for what is a kingdom without its peasants? Thus had he created the islands, and thus they remained, day after indolent day. 

Then, on a morning like any other, Farmer Hovrel drove his spade into the earth and brought up blood.
en.name: The Bleeding Earth

zh.description:
这座岛因为物产丰富被叫做丰饶岛。深色肥沃的土壤长出了闪闪发光的块茎和绿色植物。满载贡品的马车会列队摇摇晃晃地驶向王宫。 

当然，这一切都是大帝的旨意；没有农民的王境算什么？他就这样创造了这些岛屿，它们就这样日复一日地留了下来。 

然后，在一个和往常一样的早晨，农夫霍夫雷尔把他的铲子插进土里时，鲜血涌了上来。
zh.name: 流血的大地

en.description:
There was a time when the children of Duviri were educated. 

Upon the island of Academe, within its chalky caves, in rough-hewn classrooms lit by burning blue gas, sages taught them everything they would need to know. They learned of the Seven Principles, the geometries, the primords, the harmonics and resonances, the sacred stories, and most importantly, the unquestionable benignity of Dominus Thrax.

And then, not long after the Rain of Chains, the first of the Hollow Children appeared.
en.name: The Caves of Academe

zh.description:
曾经的日子里，双衍王境的孩子们是可以上学的。 

在学院岛上，有一个洞口多孔的山谷。在粉白色的洞穴里，在通过燃烧蓝色气体来照亮的简陋教室里，圣人会教给他们一切他们需要知道的关于现实的本质、七大原则、几何学、原基学、谐波和共振、神圣的故事，最重要的是，士魂大帝不容置疑的仁慈。

"锁链之雨"发生后不久，第一个空洞之子出现了。
zh.name: 学院的洞穴

en.description: How I loved the Galleria. It was an island of simple beauty, where white statues rose out of the ground as if they had grown there. They were classical in their features, masked in due propriety, each bearing an instrument or an emblem of their craft. I gave them names: the Scribe, the Scryer, the Shawzinist.
en.name: The Galleria

zh.description: 我多么喜欢艺术回廊。这是一座朴素而美丽的岛屿，白色的雕像拔地而起，就好像它们长在那里一样。他们有着古典的特征，装扮得体，每个人都佩戴着代表他们自己手艺的乐器或标志。我给他们起了名字：作家、占卜师、三线琴家。
zh.name: 艺术回廊

en.description:
In the splendid lands on this side of the Wall lives happy Mathila; and she has two children. 

She also had a husband, in her yesterdays. When I have attempted to talk to her about him she has simply frozen, like a rat before a snake. 

His name was Garmi, and he was keeper of the Seriglass Lighthouse on Watcher’s Island.
en.name: Watcher’s Island

zh.description:
在「墙」这一边的锦绣大地上，住着快乐的玛蒂拉和她的两个孩子。 

从前，她还有过一位丈夫。可每当我谈起她丈夫时，她都会像老鼠撞见了蛇一般，瞬间僵住。 

她的丈夫名叫加尔米，曾是守望者之岛上玻璃灯塔的守护人。
zh.name: 守望者之岛

en.description:
THE FIRST THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. An envious little girl, who watched as the whole world had more than she did. All the nice things, all the expensive things. And so she took what she didn’t have.

And along came a spider who told her that everyone in the world would always have more than she did. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she clung to her favorite toy and filled her life with her family and told the spider to GO! AWAY!
en.name: Along Came A Spider

zh.description:
第一根蛛丝

从前……有一个小女孩。一个嫉妒的小女孩，眼睁睁地看着全世界的人都拥有得比她多，所有美好的、昂贵的东西。于是她拿走了自己没有的。

这时来了一只蜘蛛，告诉她世界上总会有人拥有得比她多。但蜘蛛说他可以为她把这一切都吃掉。

然而，她紧紧抓住自己最爱的玩具，用家人填满自己的生活，并让蜘蛛滚——开——！
zh.name: 蜘蛛来了

en.description: Earth has been long abandoned due to its toxic atmosphere. It is now overgrown with mutated jungle structures that have devoured most of the prior signs of civilization. Infestation and roaming wildlife still inhabit its surface but anything of value was stripped by scavengers generations ago.
en.name: Earth

zh.description: 地球因其剧毒大气层已被遗弃许久。如今，疯长的突变植物丛林将过过去文明的痕迹吞噬殆尽。只有感染者和四处游荡的野生动物仍居住在地表面上，但一切有价值东西都在几个世代前被拾荒者掠夺得一干二净。
zh.name: 地球

en.description: Like most living organisms, the Grineer require water to survive. Beneath Earth's towering forest canopy are rich reserves of fresh water that the Grineer have fought hard to maintain for many years. Evidence of their long-standing occupation is found among their many outposts that have been taken hold by giant roots, moss, and other layers of vegetation over time.
en.name: Earth Settlements

zh.description: 正如同大多数生物体，Grineer 也需要水才能生存。在地球那高耸的森林下方，有着 Grineer 竭力保护多年的足量净水资源。有证据表明，在对地球长期的统治中，他们许多前线据点都被巨型的根茎，苔藓类植物或其他多层植被植物所侵蚀。
zh.name: 地球的环境

en.description: The site of the final battle between the Unum's champion, Gara, and the colossal Sentient that wished to claim the Tower's regenerative qualities for itself. Today the remains of the Sentient, diminished and confused, wander the Plains - seeking a cohesion the Ostrons hope it shall never find.
en.name: Plains of Eidolon

zh.description: 这里是乌努母神的战士，Gara，与妄图夺取高塔治愈能力的巨大 Sentient 决战的场所。如今这些 Sentient 的残骸已经变得衰退而混乱，在平野上徘徊——寻求再次的凝聚，而 Ostron 但愿这永远不会成真。
zh.name: 夜灵平野

en.description:
Many questions remain: what is the true history of Cetus? Who is the Unum and for how long has she been one with the living Tower? What is her relationship to the Quills and what hidden purpose do they serve? The Archivist, Onkko, preserved much of the old folklore but how much of that is true?

If there is any kind of scheme to the unfolding of things, some end-point in sight, then one thing is certain: the arrival of the Tenno in Cetus is no accident.
en.name: Ancient History

zh.description:
许多问题仍然存疑：希图斯真正的历史是如何的？谁又是乌努母神，她又与那座活着的塔共存了多久？她和夜羽的关系是如何的，而夜羽们又是为了什么样隐藏的目的而工作？档案保管人，昂克，保存了大量民俗知识，但其中又有多少是真实的？

假如说，事物的演变蕴含着阴谋，视野有着终点，那么有一件事是确定的：Tenno 来到希图斯绝不是偶然。
zh.name: 古老的历史

en.description:
"Khanung! Khanung! Clear Ingress Four-Two-Seven-Five! Shock charges have been affixed! Evacuate five hundred meters boomward! Prepare to make fire! Prepare to make fire!"

The Unum specifies which part of her Temple-body may be harvested, and when. In this manner her body eternally replenishes, providing her people with flesh to sell, Temple-kuva to refine and oils with which to make remarkable unguents. On occasion, nestled within the substrata of her being, a rare discovery awaits: forgotten technology. Proto-essence. Things which lure travelers from across the system, and so are a bounty for her people.
en.name: The Tower's Flesh

zh.description:
"当心！当心！清空入口4-2-7-5！冲击载荷已经附着！疏散爆破方向五百米内！准备好点火！准备好点火！"

乌努母神详细列举了她哪部分的神殿身躯可以被收割，以及何时收割。以这种方式，她的身躯可以永续地再度补充，使得她的子民有肉可以贩卖，有神殿赤毒可以精炼，有油脂可以制作非凡的药膏。偶尔，在她的基质下裹挟着稀有的发现：失落的科技。原初精华。这些东西诱惑着全星系的旅行者们，也因此成为了她的子民的宝物。
zh.name: 塔内的肉

en.description:
Swazdo-lah - a common greeting
Sho-lah - 'farewell'
Surah - 'friend'
Dah-dap - 'thank-you'
Ai yo - a common exclamation. Could be thought of as 'oh my'
Lok heb - 'hail'
Chut! - 'silence!' (request for)
Kruna metta - an imploration. 'please'.
Khanung! - a warning
Utz - a universal emphatic, appended to the end of a descriptor ("I am happy utz.") 'Very'
Doh-ga - Urgency. 'hurry'
en.name: Ostron Patois

zh.description:
Swazdo-lah - 常用问候语
Sho-lah - "再见"
Surah - "朋友"
Dah-dap - "谢谢你"
Ai yo - 常用惊叹词。可以被理解为"（哎呦，）我的天呐"
Lok heb - "打招呼"
Chut！- "安静！"（征求语气）
Kruna metta - 表示恳求。"请"。
Khanung！- 表示警告。
Utz - 表示通用的语气加强，置于形容词之后。（"我高兴 utz"。）"非常"
Doh-ga - 表示紧急。"赶快"
zh.name: Ostron 的俚语

en.description:
The Unum gives of herself, decreeing what parts of her Temple-body may be harvested for the good of Cetus. Drillers, climbing great scaffolds, punch cavities into the Temple wall which are then packed with mighty shock charges. The call ‘prepare to make fire!' echoes across the rooftops, and all know to clear the streets and alleys boomward of the harvest. The detonations rupture the sacred flesh, freeing great blanketpieces which are, in turn, pulled free and rolled down via the use of long billhooks. It is then the duty of agile balloon drop-drivers to deliver this bounty to the butchers below.

Flensers: those who carve up the Temple's flesh.

Eruptors: those who lay shock charges along chosen lines, and ‘make fire', loosening the carved flesh for removal by balloon.

Retrievers: those who wring all oil from scrubs at the end of a shift.
en.name: Tools of Harvest

zh.description:
乌努母神献出了自己，决定了她哪部分的神殿身躯是可以为了希图斯而收割的。钻工们爬上巨大的脚手架，把神殿的墙壁凿除孔洞，然后在其中填满强力的冲击载荷。"准备好点火！"的呼号响彻屋顶，所有人都知道要撤出爆破方向的街道和小巷。爆炸物割开了神圣的肉，使得大块毯状的肉松动，随后被钩镰拉扯下，并滚落。接下来就是灵巧的气球空投手的工作，将这份宝物送到下方的屠户手中。

剥皮手：这些人切开神殿的肉。

爆破手：这些人将冲击载荷安置在选好的线路上，并且"点火"，使得切开的肉松动，好让气球挪走。

回收手：这些人负责在每一班结束时拧出所有的油脂。
zh.name: 收割工具

en.description: Perhaps it is a by-product of the Sentient's body being scattered across the Plains. It may be that the Tower is here for this very reason. Or, perhaps, it's just chance… but the Plains are mineral- and resource-rich. So much so that the Grineer risk Ostron retaliation, the wrath of the Tenno and the rage of the Eidolon itself to mine this place.
en.name: Grineer Excavations

zh.description: 也许这是 Sentient 的身躯四散在平野的副产品。也许这可能是高塔坐落在这里的原因。或者，也许，只是巧合……但是平野有着丰富的矿物和资源。因此冒着被 Ostron 人报复、激怒 Tenno 和惹怒夜灵的风险，Grineer 在这里进行着采矿。
zh.name: Grineer 的挖掘

en.description: The Eidolon is no common beast of the Plains, and cannot be laid low with the tools of an everyday hunter. These ‘amps' focus the user's will into a killing beam, capable of eventually bringing one of these giant monstrosities down.
en.name: Amps

zh.description: 夜灵并非平野中一般的野兽，寻常猎人的工具难以使其屈服。这些"增幅器"，能将操控者的意志聚焦成致命的光束，最终得以将这种庞然大物击倒。
zh.name: 增幅器

en.description:
Secretive and respected, the Quills are the Unum's closest adherents. Strange and reserved, their bond to her and each other makes for a strange relationship with causality. 

"We are each one viewpoint within the myriad that comprises the Unum. We watch, we anticipate, we intercede."
en.name: The Quills of Cetus

zh.description:
行事隐秘而又备受尊重，夜羽是乌努母神最亲密的信徒。陌生而又高冷，他们与她以及他们之间的纽带通过因果产生了一种奇特的关联。

"我们是组成乌努母神的无穷视角之一。我们监察，我们预测，我们斡旋。"
zh.name: 希图斯的夜羽

en.description:
"Attachment is pain. Whatever you wish to gain or lose is a door, behind which lies grace."

"My door is a shipment of rubedo and the cost of opening it would be...?"

"3000 credits, plus tax."
en.name: Merchants of Cetus

zh.description:
"依恋是一种痛苦。不论你希望获得什么还是失去什么都是一道门，门后则有着恩典。"

"我的门是一批红化结晶，而打开它的代价是……？"

"3000 现金，不含税。"
zh.name: 希图斯的商人

en.description: The Orokin Empire may have receded into the mists of history, but what it left behind is repurposed by those who remain.
en.name: Remnants of Orokin

zh.description: 奥罗金帝国也许早已衰退在了历史的迷雾中，但是它所留下的被存活下来的人重新地改造了。
zh.name: 奥罗金的残迹

en.description: Despatched to the Plains to assist in efforts to harness and understand the Eidolons, these shock troops stand vigil over Grineer operations. They wait for the day when the power of that lobotomized Sentient might be turned to their own ends… and loosed against the walls of Cetus.
en.name: The Grineer Tusks

zh.description: 被派向平野来协助驾驭和理解夜灵，这些突击部队监守着 Grineer 的行动。他们静候着天明，在那时那些迟钝的 Sentient 的力量也许会有所收敛……并且被希图斯的墙所消耗。
zh.name: Grineer 的巨牙

en.description: Finding worth in the worthless the Ostron clade-families have built for themselves a bastion from the bones of a once-great Orokin citadel. In the eyes of an Ostron everything may serve a second purpose, and what is valueless now can be turned to serve a useful purpose later.
en.name: Scavenging Way of Life

zh.description: 通过从废物中搜刮价值，Ostron 的家族已经在这座曾经辉煌的奥罗金城堡的骨架上建立了一处堡垒。在 Ostron 人眼中，所有的东西都有其他的作用，现在无用的事物以后可以起到有益的作用。
zh.name: 拾荒的生活

en.description: The blanketpiece of temple flesh is lowered to waiting butchers and flensers. The balloon's drop-driver holds her delicate craft steady as a great airing board is positioned beneath her cargo. The Old Man gives the order: ‘Sever the mainline!'
en.name: Harvesting The Tower

zh.description: 毯状的神殿肉被下放到等待的屠户和剥皮手手中。气球空投手小心地维持着她精巧飞行器的稳定，而一块巨大的晾晒板就放在她的货物之下。一个老人发出了指令："切断主线！"
zh.name: 收割高塔

en.description: While their floating markets may ply the rails of the Origin system, Cetus is the Ostron home: a trading hub where travelers from across the system meet to exchange information, wares and plunder in safety, protected by the Unum-enforced laws of barter and parley - free from the influence of Grineer and Corpus.
en.name: Cetus

zh.description: 尽管他们的浮空市集可以定期往来于始源星系的航道，希图斯仍然是 Ostron 人的家：这是一座交易中心，全星系的旅行者在这里碰头，安全地交换信息、商品和掠夺品。这里受到乌努母神定下的交易商谈法律的保护，免受 Grineer 和 Corpus 的影响。
zh.name: 希图斯

en.description: The Ostron mercantile scavenger culture has birthed a rich tradition of artisans fluent in many styles, able to make use of whatever material is at hand to achieve stunning results. A side-effect of Temple harvesting is a light rain of gold dust, which can lead to the degenerative condition known as ‘gilded lung'. The need for masks to protect against this has led to a rich maskwork tradition unique to Cetus.
en.name: Ostron Artisans

zh.description: Ostron 重商的拾荒文化促成有着丰富传统的工匠，他们善于多种风格，能够将手中任何的材料化腐朽为神奇。神殿收割的一个副作用就是产生了金色粉尘的小雨，这导致了一种退行性疾病，被称作"镀金肺"。为了预防这种疾病，对面具的需求形成了希图斯独有的面具工艺传统。
zh.name: Ostron 的工匠

en.description: Rising from the lakes at sundown and returning to them before dawn these simple-minded monstrosities roam the nighttime plains, howling, searching for a thing they can barely remember: completeness. Wholeness. An intelligence and malevolent purpose which, fate willing, they will never return to again.
en.name: Teralyst Eidolon

zh.description: 在落日时从湖中升起，又赶在黎明前回归，这些头脑简单的庞然大物游荡在夜晚的平野中，咆哮着搜寻依稀记得的一件事：完整性。完全性。所幸，他们再也无法回归，那种智慧和恶意。
zh.name: 夜灵兆力使

en.description:
"I know us for a miracle. A million-to-one improbability. Our existence is the most fragile of all existences. We could be exterminated tomorrow, yet we have endured by wit alone for millennia."

Oro-kin-ka: spirit houses for the souls of the Orokin who once inhabited Cetus. By giving them a small house in which to reside the Ostrons hope the Orokin spirits will leave them in peace. Said to be good luck.

Yoong-bat: Urns left outside Ostron doorways, filled with fresh water for traveling monks. No-one else should drink from them, especially offworlders.
en.name: The Ostrons

zh.description:
"我们是一个奇迹。百万分之一都未必有的可能性。我们的存在是所有的存在中最脆弱的。明天，我们就可能被消灭，然而单单凭借智慧，我们经受了数个千年。"

Oro-kin-ka：曾经生活在希图斯的奥罗金人的灵魂居所。通过给灵魂一间小屋子住，Ostron 人希望奥罗金的幽灵可以不来打搅。据说会带来好运。

僧水：Ostron 人门外的瓮，灌满了清水，给云游僧喝的。其他人不可以喝，尤其是异世者。
zh.name: Ostron 人

en.description: "It is my experience of the Plains that nature adapts with greater alacrity than we. Condrocs nest in Grineer comms towers, keeping watch over the gutted Sentient husks which Kuaka rodents have transformed into colony-nests. Master Teasonai has been of great assistance to my cataloguing, striving as he does to tame all manner of wildlife." - Onkko, Cetus Archivist.
en.name: Plains Animals

zh.description: "根据我在平野的经验，自然适应得远比我们要快。秃鹰会在 Grineer 的通信塔上筑巢，不断注视着严重受损的 Sentient 躯壳，库阿卡啮齿类已经将之变成了自己的巢穴。提松奈大师对我的分类工作帮助很大，他竭尽所能地驯化了各种野生动物。"——昂克，希图斯档案保管人。
zh.name: 平野的生物

en.description:
The cry of seabirds. The delicate, permeating scent of Temple blood. The laughter of children. The shouts of merchants and hawkers. The roar of approaching spacecraft. The distant, haunting howls of the Eidolon. Cetus.

Not much ruffles an Ostron. It is as if they have made peace with whatever will be. The closeness of the Unum provides a kind of comfort, offworlders suppose. Or perhaps some of the sanguine knowingness of the enigmatic Quills have rubbed off on them.
en.name: Life In Cetus

zh.description:
海鸟的鸣叫。神殿血液弥散的轻微味道。孩童的笑语。商人和小贩的叫卖声。逼近的航天器的轰鸣。遥远而阴魂不散的夜灵咆哮。这就是希图斯。

不太有什么会触怒一个 Ostron 人。仿佛他们可以与任何东西和平共处。异世者觉得，是因为乌努母神的近临提供了一种舒适感。或者也许神秘的夜羽的一些乐观认知对他们产生了影响。
zh.name: 希图斯的生活

en.description:
"If the Unum speaks to you, traveler, it is because you have the ears to hear - though at first you may not believe it is so."

The being known by the Ostrons as ‘the Unum', and to ignorant offworlders as ‘the Wall', has a reputation for prophecy. Those wealthy enough to own moons have journeyed to Cetus, hoping to buy an audience. But the Unum has no use for wealth, and she alone decides who will hear her words, and when. 

Ostrons believe she sits at the pin-center of the universe, listening to the infinite poetry of cause-and-effect.

Some visitors to her chamber leave bitterly disappointed, others elated, others furious. But one thing is certain: the information she imparts changes the person who receives it.
en.name: The Unum

zh.description:
"如果乌努母神同你对话，旅行者，那是因为你拥有能听见的能力——虽然起初你可能不会这么认为。"

那个存在以乌努母神之名为 Ostron 所知，而无知的异世者称之为"墙"，她因为可以预知未来而名声远播。那些拥有卫星星球的富人远道而来，希望得以聆听。但是财富对于乌努母神来说没有用处，因此她自己决定何人、何时能听见她。

Ostron 人相信她位于宇宙的中心轴上，聆听着因果的无尽诗集。

有些前去她房间的参观者离去时大为失望，有些却兴高采烈，也有些怒不可遏。但是有一件事是确定的：她所透露的信息将会改变接收到之人。
zh.name: 乌努母神

en.description: There are no longer any active military or research campaigns in the Eris region – it is overrun. Long evacuated Corpus and Grineer vessels drift aimlessly in orbit, slowly being devoured by the techno-organic parasite known as the "Infestation". What remains is a twisted graveyard of partially-digested ships that are disfigured versions of their original forms… Abandoned, but not unoccupied.
en.name: Eris

zh.description: 在阋神星上没有任何战事或研究活动－此处已被彻底蹂躏。早已撤离的 Corpus 和 Grineer 舰船在阋神星轨道上漫无目的地漂流着，逐渐被以生物机械寄生虫而著称的"感染者"所吞噬。唯一剩下的只有被消化到一半、偏离原始外型的船舰……这里是被世人所遗弃，但却非空无一物的扭曲坟场。
zh.name: 阋神星

en.description: The icy moon of Jupiter, known as Europa, is home to one of the largest crash sites of the modern war. The scattered remains of a vast Corpus Obelisk litters the snowy landscape while the battle above wages on. On the otherwise lifeless surface, Corpus crew work to recover lost assets, tunneling their way through the glacial interior and restoring any and all salvageable items until financial losses are recouped.
en.name: Europa

zh.description: 欧罗巴，木星冰冷的卫星，这里是近代战争最大的战舰坠毁地。Corpus 天碑战舰散落的残骸凌乱地遍布在雪地之上，而天空中的战斗从未停息。在这毫无生机的地表，Corpus 船员努力复原损失了的财产，挖掘隧道至冰川内部，收集任何还能利用的物品，直到经济损失得以挽回为止。
zh.name: 欧罗巴

en.description: Living conditions are harsh on Europa. The surface of Jupiter's moon is flat and desolate, with a horizon of hard compacted snow that appears endless. The jagged forms of a crashed Corpus Obelisk are the only real observable landmarks above ground. Underground are caverns and tunnels of opaque ice, and crystal lakes that may have formed naturally or from the residual heat of the crashsite.
en.name: Europa Landscape

zh.description: 欧罗巴的生存条件十分严酷。这颗木星卫星的表面平坦而荒凉，远望地平线，坚硬紧实的积雪仿佛没有尽头。坠毁的 Corpus 天碑战舰以参差不齐的形式成为地面上唯一可见的景观。在地下则是由密不透光的寒冰构成的洞穴与隧道，夹杂其中的水晶湖也许是自然形成或是来自坠毁产生的余热。
zh.name: 欧罗巴景观环境

en.description:
Things have never been this bad. The currents are strengthening in that rank cesspool of a Board. Nef Anyo has consolidated his power on Venus, winning Frohd Bek’s favor. All eyes are turning toward their new darling. And the currents… the currents would drag me down.  

I am underestimated. I am unseen. I must turn that to my advantage.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 1/8

zh.description:
情况从未如此严峻过。董事会那个污水坑让暗流变得更加汹涌了。奈富·安尤已经巩固了他在金星上的力量，赢得了 Frohd Bek 的青睐。所有人都把目光转向他们的新欢。而那些暗流……会让我万劫不复。

我被低估了，被忽视了。我必须利用这一点。
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 1/8

en.description: I seek advantage and advantage appears! I'd long thought that old fool Regus dead, but here is - rich and gullible as ever! With an offer of shared wealth. Says he has tech like I've never seen! Old War tech. And he wants an investor. Oh, I'll invest all right…
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 2/8

zh.description: 我寻求机遇，机遇就送上门来了！我一直以为那个老傻瓜 Regus 已经死了，可瞧瞧现在——他跟以前一样有钱又容易上当受骗！他提供了一个能一起牟利的途径。他说他有我从未见过的技术！远古之战的技术，而且他想要一个投资人。哦，我会投资的……
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 2/8

en.description: This is about more than investment. Regus surprises me. How a man of his limited intellect came by such wonders is…. But… forget that. What he has is… exceptionally viable. Where did he find this technology? It stinks of Tau, but the advantages to be had in the exploitation of it… the things I could create… the profits I could accrue… the Board will never dare underestimate me again!
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 3/8

zh.description: 这不仅仅是投资的问题。Regus 让我感到震惊。一个像他这样脑子不灵光的人是如何取得这样的奇迹的……但是……算了。他现在所拥有的技术……尽管诡异，但却可行。他是在哪里找到了这项技术？它散发着来自 Tau 星系的恶臭，但只要合理利用，它就能让我取得优势……想想那些我能借此创造出来的东西……我能获得的利润……董事会再也不敢低估我了！
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 3/8

en.description:
Regus' price was high, but I dangled the Board's most enticing intellectual property, SysComm, to seal the deal.  Then I placed a contract, loaded with escape clauses and loopholes, in that slack, idiot's fingers… And he signed! The fool signed without even reading it!

Any partner that thick is a liability. A liability soon to be nullified.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 4/8

zh.description:
Regus 的要价很高，但是我拿出了董事会最诱人的知识产权，SysComm，作为交易筹码。随后，我起草了一份合同，里面附加了各种免责条款和漏洞，并把它交到了那个懒散的白痴手里……然后他签了名！这个笨蛋连看都没有看就签了名！

任何一个迟钝的合作伙伴都是一种负担。一种很快就会被废弃的负担。
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 4/8

en.description:
Regus has changed. Or, perhaps, he is not such a fool... and today I saw beneath the mask. He is no longer so agreeable. Rather he came to our meeting with a raft of his own, radical, proposals. An entire shift in direction. And then, as I made to leave, he smiled. He smiled and, for just a second, I don't think his face was human at all. 

This is all wrong. I'm tearing up the contract. I have a terrible feeling that if do not escape this partnership immediately, I never will.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 5/8

zh.description: Regus 变了。或者，也许，他根本就不傻……今天我看到他面具下的真面目了。他不再那么讨人喜欢了。相反地，他来参加我们的会议时，提出了大量他自己的激进建议。整个战略方向的转变。然后，当我准备离开时，他冲我笑了。他笑了，但就在那一瞬间，我觉得他的脸根本就不像人类。这一切都是错误。我要撕毁这份合同。有一种可怕的感觉萦绕在我的心头，如果再不立即摆脱这种合伙关系，我会永远无法脱身。
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 5/8

en.description:
That was not Regus. It was never Regus. It revealed its true face to me and… by the Void. I've entered into a partnership… with Sentients. The world-builders, the world-killers. Our enemy under all. This contract is worthless. Instead, they demand submission. 

CT! Assemble the disciples. Arm the Condors. Those oversized crustaceans have no idea who they're dealing with.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 6/8

zh.description:
那不是 Regus，它从来就不是 Regus。它通过虚空……给我展示了它的真面目。原来……我和 Sentient 结成了合伙关系。那些世界的改造者，世界的毁灭者。我们所有人的劲敌。这份合同毫无价值。相反，它们要求我的服从。

终端机！召集信徒们，武装好秃鹫空投艇。让那些巨大的甲壳生物明白自己到底在跟谁打交道。
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 6/8

en.description:
That did not go as planned. Thousands against one. That massive grotesque tore through my forces like a shark through a shoal. We never inflicted so much as a scratch.

Now it perches outside my home. The message is clear. I am to make Amalgams, and if I cross them, the Ropalolyst makes an ash cloud of this city.

If my rivals find out, I'll be executed for treason. What choice do I have but to comply?
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 7/8

zh.description:
事情没能按计划进行。千军万马对付一只怪物。那个大家伙像鲨鱼穿过浅滩一样撕裂着我的部队。而我们却无法伤到它分毫。

现在，它就栖息在我的家门外。这一切所要传达的信息已经很明显了。我得开始制造并合体了，如果我反抗它们的话，蝠力使就会把这座城市变为废墟。

如果我的竞争对手们发现了我的背叛行为，那我肯定会遭到处决。可现在，我除了服从，还有什么选择呢？
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 7/8

en.description:
Disciples! Good news! The Amalgam program has entered into a fruitful partnership. Pursuant to our agreement, their identities will be kept confidential, and a strict no-fly zone shall be instated around their craft.

In time the nature of our project will be made known. Until then know that we work for a brighter Corpus future! Life is Profit.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 8/8

zh.description: 信徒们！好消息！并合计划缔结了一段富有成效的合伙关系。根据我们的协议，他们的身份会得到保密，而他们的飞船周围也会设立严格的禁飞区。 假以时日，我们的计划终会被世人所知。在那一刻来临之前，请所有人谨记，我们是在为 Corpus 光明未来而奋战！生命，就是为了盈利！
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 8/8

en.description:
The children of Cetus can often be found chasing one another through streets and around landing bays, when not helping their families with chores or the running of businesses. Traditional games are popular, such as ‘Shunta' or ‘Kubrow and Vobi'. They can be found playing riding sticks, or floating boats made from stale, hollowed-out loaves of bread. 

Since the arrival of the Tenno a new form of play has emerged, in which children act out the tales they have heard of the Tenno.
en.name: Childhood Games

zh.description:
当不需要帮家里干杂活或者照看生意的时候，希图斯的孩童们经常在街道和着陆湾中嬉戏追逐。传统的游戏非常流行，比如"Shunta"或者"库狛与沃比"。有时会看到他们骑在树枝上玩耍，或者用不新鲜的中空面包当做小船漂在水中。

自从 Tenno 到来之后，一种新的游戏出现了，孩童们表演着听来的 Tenno 传说。
zh.name: 儿时游戏

en.description:
The word ‘cetus', in the Ostron tongue, means ‘landless, cladeless; a body turned to dust turned to motes on a careless wind.' History says the town was founded as a home for anyone, regardless of clade, trade or origin. Friendships last a lifetime here. It is easy to imagine how, in the earliest days of Cetus - with the Eidolons roaming the Plains, the walls laid low and Grineer war parties pressing in - mutual support and protection would have been essential. 

As times have improved this trait has become a key part of Ostron culture.
en.name: Friendship

zh.description:
在 Ostron 人的语言中，"希图斯"意味着"没有土地，没有家族，随时可能在风中飘散成灰的人"。据历史所述，这座村庄建立时接纳了所有人，不论家族、职业和血统。在这里友谊长存。不难想象，在希图斯建立的早期——平野上有夜灵游荡，高墙倒伏，而 Grineer 战斗部队大军压境——因此互助协防一直都是至关重要的。

随着时代的进步，这种特质已经成为了 Ostron 文化的关键。
zh.name: 友情

en.description:
What is known of the ancient warrior known as Gara comes to us from folklore and oral tradition. It is said she was the Unum's closest companion, and that when the Lotus instructed her children to flee Gara remained, refusing to leave the side of the one she loved best. 

When the Sentient was done razing a great many other Towers, when it turned its myriad eyes and receptors toward the Unum, it was Gara who gave herself to protect her friend - shattering the Sentient. The mindless monstrosities that now stride the Plains - the Teralysts - are all that remain of it.
en.name: The Glass Warrior

zh.description:
被称作 Gara 的古代战士因民间故事与口耳相传的传说而广为人知。据说她是乌努母神最亲密的伴侣，当 Lotus 命令她的孩子们逃离时，Gara 留了下来，拒绝离开她挚爱的身边。

当那 Sentient 夷平了许多其他高塔时，当它将无数的眼睛和感知器探向乌努母神时，是 Gara 献出生命保护了她——破碎了那只 Sentient。兆力使——这些无意识的怪物如今在平野上横行，则是它的的残余。
zh.name: 玻璃战士

en.description: The distant, mournful howls of the Eidolon - yearning for the terror it once was - drift through the alleys and byways, across rooftops, to the ears of sleeping families.
en.name: Night In Cetus

zh.description: 夜灵遥远悲凄的哀嚎——渴求着昔日的恐怖——流转过小巷和旁路，穿过屋顶，进入熟睡的家庭耳中。
zh.name: 希图斯的夜晚

en.description:
Chimurr: Fill the gourd with bomba leaves, then add steaming water and imbibe through a burnished juta reed. A very old Ostron tradition. To serve it to guests signifies union and friendship. 

Harpu: fresh-brewed chimurr with melted vobi butter creates a filling, tasty beverage. It is often bulked out with salt and balb flour. Always served hot. 

Daku liquor: highly sought after. The Suma Doni (a lowlands marsupial) eats the peca nut, then excretes a fine paste. It is from this paste that Ostrons make daku liquor. 

Golden caviar: harvested from abyssal depths such as the Geonate Shelf. 

Kubuchi: fermented sorghum. Cheap liquor. No Ostron would be caught drinking it in public. Any offworlder who does is immediately seen as a greenhorn and an easy mark. 

Wine: some merchants claim to be able to imbue a bottle with the ‘etheric signature' of a person one wishes to be rid of. Drink them in the evening, expel them by morning. 

Ito-da (termite droppings): Mineral-dense. Will keep a traveler going long after hunger should have dropped them.
en.name: Ostron Cuisine

zh.description:
赤穆茶：将葫芦装满 bomba 叶，再加入开水，用一根铮亮的朱塔芦苇吸着喝。这是一种非常古老的 Ostron 传统，用来招待客人以彰显团结和友谊。

Harpu：刚酿好的赤穆茶和沃比黄油一起融化，创造出一道能填饱肚子的美味饮品。常常用盐和巴柏面粉使之膨胀。永远热腾腾地上桌。

Daku 酒：非常热门。Suma Doni（一种低地有袋类）吃下芘卡胡桃，排出精细的糊。从这种糊中 Ostron 人制作出 daku 酒。

黄金鱼子酱：收获自深海的深渊，比如 Geonate 大陆架。

库布奇酒：发酵的高粱。一种廉价的酒。Ostron 人绝对不会在公开场合喝它。任何公开喝这种酒的异世者立刻会被看做是好骗的愣头青。

葡萄酒：有些商人号称可以在瓶中注入你想要摆脱之人的"醚特征签名"。晚上灌醉那人，白天就能赶走了。

Ito-da（白蚁粪便）：富含矿物质。可以在饥饿击倒旅行者之前，让他们支撑很久。
zh.name: Ostron 料理

en.description: The sprawling military ranks of the Grineer empire are formed of rotting hordes of simpleton clones, bent on consuming everything that remains of the Origin System. They live short, violent lives, much of it an inheritance of their genetic stunting by their former Orokin masters.
en.name: Grineer

zh.description: Grineer 帝国中延绵不绝的军事阶层构成了这群腐朽而低智慧的复制人军队，他们决心将始源星系的残存价值消耗殆尽。由于多数 Grineer 受到过往主人奥罗金基因发展不全遗传的影响，他们的生命周期短且易骤逝。
zh.name: Grineer

en.description:
"It came through the wall. All I remember is the roar, the open maw… the rank foulness of its breath. The lolling tongue. And… the way two of my friends were crushed between it and our grain silo. The way it seemed to fall in love with tearing them apart, over and over and over…"
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
en.name: Devourer

zh.description:
"它破墙而至。我只记得那吼声，那张开的巨颚……那带有强烈腐臭味的吐息，垂下的舌头，还有……它将我的两个朋友连同我们的粮仓一起咬碎。它一遍又一遍地撕咬，似乎非常享受将猎物撕碎的快感……"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。
zh.name: 吞噬者

en.description:
"Its arms shot forward, the drills ratcheting outward… passing in and out of Horvath's body like it was nothing. I can still hear the screech of the drills. The maddening chatter of its teeth. Horvath's screams."
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
en.name: Augur

zh.description:
"它的双臂向前弹射出去，那钻头旋转着飞出……Horvath 的身体如同薄纸一般，瞬间就被刺破。即便是现在，我依然能听到那钻头发出的啸叫声，那牙齿所发出的狂乱之语，还有 Horvath 的哀嚎。"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。
zh.name: 钻孔者

en.description:
"It came at me, wailing, like a lost thing screaming for help. Then it wrapped its clay-cold arms about me… and here I am. Barely anything left of me now, lying in this bed, except a few stories… and the memory of its face. Like a newborn child."
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
en.name: The Expired

zh.description:
"它朝我过来，哀号着，如同一只正在求救的生物。随后，它用如同陶土般冰冷的手臂将我缠住……把我变成了现在这副样子。我拖着一副所剩无几的身体，躺在床上，如同一个新生儿。现在我所剩下的，只有一些故事……和关于它样貌的记忆。"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。
zh.name: 除役者

en.description:
"Konzu gave us standing orders. Shoot the sawmen first. We'd seen what they had done to our brothers and sisters. That was not going to happen to us."
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
en.name: Rictus

zh.description:
"孔尊给我们下达了作战命令。先朝那些电锯兵射击。我们已经见识过他们对我们的兄弟姊妹所做的事。我们绝不能让那些悲剧在我们身上重演。"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。
zh.name: 裂嘴者

en.description:
I came to the Eidolon Plains not to explore horror, but to lay to rest an ancient mystery. It would seem, horror had something to say, regardless.

The Ghouls. Grown in darkness, beneath the feet of the enemy. Born to fight.. To kill… and to die.

Truly, of all the places horror may call home, it is most comfortable within the imaginings of men.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Ghouls

zh.description:
我来到夜灵平野并不是为了探寻恐怖之物，而是为了解开一个上古谜团。不过，这趟旅途似乎终究无法摆脱恐怖的萦绕。

尸鬼。成长于敌人脚下的黑暗之中。生来就是为了战斗……杀戳……和死亡。

实话说，尽管恐怖之物可以出现在很多地方，但它们最喜欢的地方，还是人们的脑海。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 尸鬼

en.description:
The Ghouls are designed to a simple philosophy: victory assured, through overwhelming numbers and the element of surprise.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Overwhelming Numbers

zh.description:
尸鬼被设计为一种头脑简单的生物：他们只会通过人海和突袭战术来取得胜利。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 人海战术

en.description:
Sudden terror… the element of surprise… and cheaply bought. Ghouls are shock troops, fast-grown in diapause bags, cultured from repurposed Grineer gene slurry. The key to victory is quantity over quality. A tide of claws and flesh to crush any enemy foolish enough to stand before it.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: A Tide of Claws and Flesh

zh.description:
突现的恐怖……偷袭战术……且成本低廉。尸鬼是突击部队，他们能在休眠袋中以惊人的速度成长，通过改造过的 Grineer 基因浆培育。用数量代替质量是他们的制胜理念。任何胆敢阻挡他们的对手，都会被潮水一般的利爪和血肉所粉碎。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 利爪与血肉之潮

en.description:
While not of Vor's design, the General uses the ghouls to good effect.

Credit for the development of these horrors goes to none other than Doctor Tengus: father of the infamously unstable Grustrag 3. Developed in his laboratories, against the wishes of Vor himself, and with the funding of a certain ill-fated Counsellor… the Ghouls are Tengus' crowning achievement. 

They have secured the Doctor's place in the good graces of the Grineer Queens.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Doctor Tengus

zh.description:
尽管尸鬼并非出自沃尔之手，但这位将军很好地运用了尸鬼的能力。

在这恐怖之物的研发过程中起到关键作用的人，自然要算 Tengus 博士——他是臭名昭彰的 Grustrag 三霸之父。尽管沃尔反对这项研究计划，但某位命运多舛的议员却为之提供了资金支持，并最终让尸鬼的研究获得成功……尸鬼是 Tengus 所取得的最高成就。

博士也因此获得了 Grineer 女皇们的嘉奖。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: Tengus 博士

en.description:
Ghouls are far from the finest of Grineer troops, but what they lack in martial skill they make up for in sheer horrifying volume.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Strength In Numbers

zh.description:
尸鬼远远不是 Grineer 最优秀的士兵，但他们军事技能上的缺陷由绝对的恐怖数量所弥补。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 数量即是力量

en.description:
Ghouls are deployed in advance of regular Grineer troops. Before then, those troops must keep the ghouls sated… lest they turn upon those who failed to feed them.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Shock Troops

zh.description:
尸鬼会被部署在常规 Grineer 部队之前。直到部署前，必须先满足尸鬼的口腹……以免他们倒戈攻击喂不饱他们的部队。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 突袭部队

en.description:
Especially degenerate Ghoul specimens are employed as suicide troops
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Born To Die

zh.description:
尤其是那些退化了的尸鬼样本，被用作自杀部队。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 为死而生

en.description:
They are incapable of fear. Relentless.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Unstoppable

zh.description:
他们无法感到恐惧、残酷无情。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 无可阻挡

en.description:
Massive casualties may be inflicted upon massed ranks of ghouls without slowing their advance.

This is a new phase in the Grineer campaign for dominance in the Origin System.

One that has increased the stakes for every sentient being who calls it home.

Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: A New Phase

zh.description:
大规模的尸鬼部队可以造成巨量的杀伤，并且他们的行进速度完全不会受到影响。

这是 Grineer 统治始源星系战役的全新阶段。

在这个阶段里，对于以此为家的众生而言，是更加危险了。

西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 新的阶段

en.description: Strict laws on organic engineering impose severe mental and physical health limitations on the Grineer labour force. Whatever standard human stock they were originally derived from has been lost. Compliant and high-performing variants are often technically augmented to extend their lifespans beyond the few decades they can normally expect in operation.
en.name: Grineer Labour

zh.description: 生物工程上的严酷律法在 Grineer 劳动力身上强加了心理与生理上的严重缺陷。最初这批劳力是从何而来的已经不为人知。顺从听话而又表现良好的变种往往会通过技术手段强化来延长他们的寿命，活过原本仅仅数十载的预期运行寿命。
zh.name: Grineer 劳工

en.description: Grineer are all clones from a genetic pool of ‘Originals'. They are able to extend their lifespans with recycled cloned parts, but their genetic material has degraded over time, and haphazard repairs have made many of them look oddly deformed and susceptible to skin diseases. Through decades of service, many of the Grineer elite can cover the expense to have flawed organic parts replaced with cybernetic augmentations.
en.name: Grineer Leadership

zh.description: Grineer 全体皆是由"原始基因"的基因库复制生产而来。他们能回收使用复制的器官部位来延长寿命，然而 Grineer 基因物质的恶化程度也会与日俱增。杂乱无章的修补导致众多 Grineer 的外貌产生了诡异的残缺且易受皮肤疾病的影响。在献身种族数十年后，许多 Grineer 精英能负担起将缺陷部位替换成神经机械的费用。
zh.name: Grineer 领导阶层

en.description: Unlike the Corpus, the Grineer are not celebrated for their ingenuity and craftsmanship. Their notoriety is steeped in violence and military proficiency. However, the Grineer have proven quite inventive and capable of developing their own technologies throughout history. Hiding beneath scrap metal plates, fading paint, and recycled components are qualified devices used for research, manufacturing, and warfare.
en.name: Grineer Technology

zh.description: 与 Corpus 不同，Grineer 并不以创新和技艺而闻名。他们的在暴力和军事能力上臭名昭著。不过纵观历史 Grineer 还是体现出了一定的创造与科技发展能力。隐藏在废金属板、暗淡的涂装和回收利用的组件之下，是用来研究、制造和作战的合格设备。
zh.name: Grineer 科技

en.description: The Infestation spreads across the Origin System – a techno-organic parasite that attaches itself to natural and synthetic forms, slowly digesting the host subject and transforming it on a molecular level. Organic materials morph into new homogeneous organisms while harder, inorganic materials, like metals, will change structurally into a pseudo-organic substance that holds the characteristics of its previous forms.
en.name: Infestation

zh.description: 这群肆虐了整座始源星系的感染者是一种生物科技的寄生体，它们将自己寄生在天然和人工合成物上，以融合的形式缓慢消化宿主，在分子级别上转化宿主。被寄生者体内的有机物质会因此异变为同质有机体，接着，无机物质将会改变结构，成为保有过去宿主特征的伪有机物。
zh.name: 感染者

en.description: Infestation of a living natural organism and the transformation of its molecular structure happens much more rapidly than with large synthetic ships or machinery. Infested nanites quickly break down organic tissue and begin to evolve the existing specimen into a new organism with characteristics and functions ideal for survival and self-defense. In many cases, visible traces of the victim's original form are still visible in the new mutated form – a stark and horrifying memorial.
en.name: Infested

zh.description: 感染者是活生生的自然有机体，在与大型综合船只或机械结合时，其分子结构的改变会发生更加快速。Infested 纳米机器能迅速分解有机组织，再将现有的样本发展成特征与机能为最适合生存与自我防卫的新有机体。在多数情况下，被害者原有的形态变异后还能被辨认出来——聊以作为一个凄凉恐怖的纪念。
zh.name: 感染

en.description: It is not impossible to mine a star. Rich with liquid metallic resources, the gas-giant Jupiter challenges harvesters with increased gravity, intense magnetic fields, and extreme temperatures. Only the most tenacious profiteers would dare operate here. Prevailing science of Corpus industry thrives in the clouds of Jupiter’s outer atmosphere.
en.name: Jupiter

zh.description: 开采一颗星星并非不可能。巨大的气体星球木星有着丰富液态金属资源，其重力、强力磁场和极端温度，都是开采者将会面临到的挑战，只有最坚毅的投机者敢来此进行投资。Corpus 工业的主流科技在木星的外层大气中茁壮成长。
zh.name: 木星

en.description: Warframe operative insertion craft come in many designs, but they are all commonly classified as short-range stealth aircraft. Fuselage insertion stingers will torpedo the Warframe into the hull of the target undetected, and the landing craft will re-position at the extraction point. Between engagements, the landing craft is latched to its sister component, an Orbiter.
en.name: Landing Craft

zh.description: Warframe 特工的渗透飞行器有很多种设计，不过大多属于短距离隐身飞船。船体入侵器会将 Warframe 神不知鬼不觉地投射到目标船体内，随后登陆艇会移动至撤离点。在作战任务之间，登陆艇与它的姐妹舰——轨道飞行器连接。
zh.name: 登陆艇

en.description: Functioning agents of the Infestation appear in a variety of horrific forms. While some infested organisms take the relative shape and physical properties of a newly acquired host, older entities have taken unique and transformative shapes of their own, adapting to their environment over time, and absorbing new victims to feed their evolution.
en.name: Lephantis

zh.description: 可活动的感染者有着各种可怖的形态。尽管一些被感染生物的形状和物理性质与新捕获的宿主大体相同，较老的个体则已经变化成了自己独有的形状，以逐渐适应环境并吸收新的被害者来促成进化。
zh.name: 雷凡魔像

en.description: Guiding light to the newly-awakened Tenno, the Lotus is a mysterious companion and mentor who works from an unknown remote location. Her past is rich with storied history, and her knowledge of the known universe, past and present, rivals even the most studious Cephalon intelligence. Her reach is far, her allies are many, but her ultimate intentions are of dubious propriety.
en.name: Lotus

zh.description: 总是在远方未知之处的 Lotus 是刚醒 Tenno 的引导之光，是 Tenno 的神秘伙伴与指引者。她的过去是充满传奇的历史，而她对过去与当下的宇宙知识，可以匹敌最勤学的中枢智能。她的影响力十分广泛、盟友众多，但她的最终意图仍令人存疑。
zh.name: Lotus

en.description: A primitive and devout civilization was carved into the dust-filled canyons of Mars. These aging and severely eroded habitations miraculously remain intact, regardless of how much Grineer machinery has been fastened to it. Rusty metal and oil-soaked sand mark the territory of its new proprietors.
en.name: Mars

zh.description: 在火星上，曾有一支原始且信仰虔诚的文明座落在遍地沙尘的峡谷当中。无论 Grineer 在此设立了多少机械设施，这些老化、饱受侵蚀的前人居所奇迹般地保持了原貌，只是生锈的金属与油腻的沙子标志着这里的新主人。
zh.name: 火星

en.description: Galleon fleets keep watch over the Grineer mining operations that penetrate Mercury's asteroid field. Cavernous rooms and twisting metal corridors mark where labourers have stripped the region for crucial resources, transforming the natural landscape to support Grineer occupancy.
en.name: Mercury

zh.description: 目前 Grineer 的帆船舰队正看守着贯通整个水星小行星带的采矿作业。巨穴结构的空间和扭曲的金属廊道，标志着劳工们剥开这里搜刮重要的资源，将自然景观转化为对 Grineer 占领的支撑。
zh.name: 水星

en.description: Gold rings circle and encapsulate the desolate moonscape – lavish architecture signifying the Orokin mastery over all things natural and technological during their reign. The opalescent halls stitching together what the enemy destroyed have been vacated since that era came to an end.
en.name: Lua

zh.description: 金色的圆环围绕着荒凉的月球表面－奢华的建筑象征着奥罗金在统治期间内掌控了自然、技术与一切万物。自从奥罗金时代结束以后，那些连接着被摧毁区域的乳白色大厅已经空无一人。
zh.name: 月球

en.name: Lullaby of the Manifold - Adis's Lament

zh.name: 万物摇篮曲 - 阿迪斯的哀歌

en.description: The Corpus have perfected automated manufacturing and continue to demonstrate maximum efficiency producing the robotic proxies they build to serve them. Immaculate production lines and flawless technical engineering ensure that the production of robotics and intelligent, synthetic machines continues in perpetuity.
en.name: Neptune

zh.description: Corpus 拥有完美的自动化生产，并持续展现出制造自用代理机器的极致效率。洁净的生产线和完善的工程技术保证了机器人与智能综合机械的生产可以永续进行。
zh.name: 海王星

en.description: Tenno operatives are a highly mobile strike force, and their property must be equally itinerant. Smaller landing crafts dock with the larger Orbiter shuttle where transient warriors can house their arsenal, foundry, and research systems.
en.name: Orbiter

zh.description: Tenno 操控者们是一股高机动性武力，他们的根据地势必居无定所。小型登陆艇停靠在更大的轨道飞行器上，在那里这群流浪战士安置了他们的军械库、铸造场与研究系统。
zh.name: 轨道飞行器

en.description: Even the most culturally and technologically advanced civilization in history could not contain the menace of the Infestation. After an unknown cataclysmic event propelled them from the Void, Orokin vessels were left adrift, becoming uninhabited and overgrown. The tireless force of probing infested tendrils penetrate and dislodge the once majestic and opulent halls of these Orokin vessels.
en.name: Orokin Derelict

zh.description: 即便是在过去历史中最具文化及先进科技的文明，也无法控制感染者造成的危害。在不明的灾难事件发生后，奥罗金退出了虚空，空无一人的船只便被遗留在虚空中任其漂流。而感染者不断滋生的探测卷须贯穿并肢解了一座座奥罗金飞船中曾经辉煌繁华的大厅。
zh.name: 奥罗金遗迹

en.description: The highly revered Orokin civilization built sovereignty on a culture of art, technology and architecture. To prove oneself worthy of elevated social status, one must face Orokin trials in the golden and majestic Halls of Ascension. At one time a utopian society of omniscient leadership, the great Orokin Era ended in a divine realization of their own ignorance.
en.name: Orokin

zh.description: 崇高的奥罗金文明立身于艺术、科技和建筑文化，打造了一个主权帝国。如欲证明自身得以匹配更高的社会地位，则必须面对金色宏伟的晋升大厅的奥罗金试炼。这个曾经在全知全能领导下的乌托邦社会，伟大的奥罗金时代最终在由自身的无知引起的神罚中宣告终结。
zh.name: 奥罗金

en.description: Phobos has always been a highly contested area. Skirmishes between the tireless Grineer and Corpus factions occur in orbit and on the Martian moon surface. Unanswered questions about this natural satellite still remain as all research is endlessly delayed by war.
en.name: Phobos

zh.description: 火卫一历来是兵家必争之地。Grineer 与 Corpus 在火卫一的轨道和表面展开了无休止的征战。而这颗天然卫星残留着的不解之谜，其研究至今仍被战乱而无限期回柜。
zh.name: 火卫一

en.description: Weapons research and manufacturing is a large component of Corpus industry. Their designs are clean and precisely engineered, and they are the largest supplier of energy-based weapons in the Origin System. These cunning profiteers prefer to avoid conflict in times of war, dealing arms indiscriminately to any side that can afford the price.
en.name: Corpus Weapons

zh.description: 武器研究及生产是 Corpus 工业领域的一大部分。他们的设计十分简洁并且极其精密，同时他们还是始源星系内最大的能量武器供应商。这群狡诈的奸商更愿意在战时躲避直接交火，然后在有利益可乘之际，一视同仁地向任何付得起钱的人贩卖军火。
zh.name: Corpus 的武器

en.description: Pluto is small and cold, and organic tissue does not fare well in its extreme climate. But the merchant spacemen always seek opportunity for profit in regions where others dare not travel. Robotic proxies act as security in the largely un-manned manufacturing facilities that operate in the area.
en.name: Pluto

zh.description: 冥王星是气候寒冷的小型星球，有机组织在此难以生长。但是太空商人总是会在其他人不敢去的地方寻觅商机。代理机器人会在此地运作中的大型无人生产设施里担任安保要务。
zh.name: 冥王星

en.description: A vision comes, something new is stirring within the ground. Seeking a body to call its own; longing to strike those who sent it to the grave.
en.name: A New Threat Looms

zh.description: 一个影像出现了，全新的威胁在地底搅动。寻求着成为自身的身体，渴望着伏击将其送入坟墓之人。
zh.name: 新的威胁暗中蠢动

en.description: A fragment of the ancient Sentient that once terrorized these plains.
en.name: A Terror Long Forgotten

zh.description: 曾经威胁着这平野的远古 Sentient 的一片碎片。
zh.name: 久远遗忘的恐怖

en.description: The warden of the plains, tasked with striking down the ever-returning ghostly Eidolon that threatened the Unum's Tower. Night after night, he cut them down. Then one night, he disappeared, lost… forever.
en.name: The Lost One

zh.description: 平野的看守者，被赋予了击倒那鬼魅夜灵的任务，这只不断试图回归的夜灵曾经威胁了到了乌努母神之塔。夜复一夜，他将其击倒。但某一个晚上，他消失了，永远地……迷失了。
zh.name: 迷失者

en.description: Computing devices, weapons, ship parts and robotics – the Corpus are on the bleeding edge of high-technology development. Precisely machined metals and flexible synthetic composites are signature to the animalistic robots that the Corpus have built as their proxies. Artificial intelligence in these robotics is robust, but intentionally restricted, ensuring a capable but subservient workforce.
en.name: Robotics

zh.description: 从电脑设备、武器、船舰组件到机器人－Corpus 总是位于最新技术发展的尖端。柔性的合成复合材料是 Corpus 用以制造类兽形代理机器人的特征。这些代理机器人的人工智慧虽然非常强大，但却被刻意设下限制，为的是确保其服从性及工作能力。
zh.name: 机器人

en.description: The historically well-travelled merchant shipping lanes of Saturn are now dominated by Grineer blockades. Heavy military influence populates this area where Grineer Commanders believe they have a strategic foothold on travel throughout the System. Under the safeguard of patrolling Galleons, the Grineer ceaselessly train their expanding forces, making the region nigh impossible to overtake.
en.name: Saturn

zh.description: 土星历史上最常被利用的商业航线，现在已被 Grineer 封锁。整片区域皆被这支大军所影响，Grineer 指挥官相信他们已占据了星系航行的战略要点。在帆船舰队来回巡逻的保护之下，Grineer 不断训练他们的扩张武力，以致在此区域近乎无人可超越其势力。
zh.name: 土星

en.description: If there are new discoveries to make or ancient tools of war yet to be excavated, the Grineer want to be there first — at the frontier of space exploration. Always seeking the upper-hand against their foes, they have numerous deployments that border the known reaches of our Origin System, poised to enter brave new territory and unexplored space on command.
en.name: Sedna

zh.description: 若在太空探索的边境之中，还有哪里能有新的发现或挖出古老的战争工具 — Grineer 绝对会第一个抵达。Grineer 总是在寻找优势攻击敌人，在我们所知的始源星系边缘，他们部署了无数的军队准备踏上新的领地，听从命令探索未知的太空。
zh.name: 赛德娜

en.description:
Things have never been this bad. The currents are strengthening in that rank cesspool of a Board. Nef Anyo has consolidated his power on Venus, winning Frohd Bek’s favor. All eyes are turning toward their new darling. And the currents… the currents would drag me down.  

I am underestimated. I am unseen. I must turn that to my advantage.

zh.description:
情况从未如此严峻过。董事会那个污水坑让暗流变得更加汹涌了。奈富·安尤已经巩固了他在金星上的力量，赢得了 Frohd Bek 的青睐。所有人都把目光转向他们的新欢。而那些暗流……会让我万劫不复。

我被低估了，被忽视了。我必须利用这一点。
